Oncology
Compassionate, Advanced Cancer Care for Pets
The Oncology team at VSRC provides specialized, cutting-edge care for pets facing cancer. We combine advanced diagnostics, targeted therapies, and individualized treatment plans to deliver care that is both highly effective and deeply compassionate.
Every patient is treated as a unique individual, and every treatment plan is developed in collaboration with pet families and referring veterinarians. VSRC offers treatment with the first-in-class IGEA Clinivet electroporation system, an innovative technology that enhances chemotherapy drug absorption using targeted electrical pulses. This technique allows for more effective, focused treatment of tumors and tumor beds (surgical scars), while minimizing patient side effects.

Oncology Services We Offer
A Note from Dr. Brooke Britton
VSRC Oncology provides treatment for the full spectrum of cancers and their associated health conditions, with a deep commitment to honoring and preserving the relationships surrounding each patient — families, caregivers, and the referring veterinary community alike – throughout all phases of their therapy and long-term management.
With cancer, there is always a degree of fear, uncertainty, and stress. It is the work of the Oncology care team to be perceptive, compassionate, and do what we can to minimize ‘caregiver burden’ – the weight that one bears, over time, as one deals with the fear, the uncertainty, and the stress that comes with discovering that a loved one has a serious or terminal diagnosis, and accompanying them on the journey that is cancer treatment, as well as ‘the beyond’ – what happens after treatment has completed. We are here for you, and walk beside you, every step of this journey.
Through the years, Oncology treatment for animals has developed into a sophisticated and comprehensive science, and we offer state-of-the-art, proactive treatment plans and avail patients of all options. Our highest responsibility however is to improve and preserve quality of life. The art of Oncology practice lies in knowing how to see the individual for who they are, and the ability to tailor treatment to their personality and tolerance. The skillful practice of Oncology requires both medical expertise as well as command of the art. What successful treatment looks like with any given individual may be very different, depending upon the specific cancer and treatment goals. At VSRC Oncology, through transparent, compassionate communication, we provide the information and support you need to make informed decisions about your pet’s cancer care throughout the entirety of their journey.
Our team looks forward to working with you and your companion, in the pursuit of health and hope.”
Brooke Britton DVM DACVIM (Oncology)
